name: goal-between-inner
text:
import Prelude
def k : Nat → Nat := by
  exact (by intro x; exact x)
note: between the two inner steps: the state after `intro x`, not the outer step's. The selfhost matches today because `intro`'s word-searched fallback span contains the caret (not because an inner block entry exists); 4b makes it match for the right reason. The caret is not a span-less position, so there is no knownGap.
